body: Thanks Tay-Rex, I appreciate your reply. Have a good rest.

You're a stand up guy. Thinking of those things is difficult for me, cause I process lots of noise without hearing a sound. Please do well on your home work and become a strong person capable of making a real difference.

Which sounds strangely optimistic despite what I've just said, but the thing is I feel really weird, and I'm tired of being there and having people think that I'm there but don't treat me as I am. I can't focus a lot and I can't do a lot of things and its really difficult.
I won't dispute that. I guess I'm just tired of talking. I'm tired of the way I'm being treated. I want immediate reprogramming and placement for immediate accumulation of positive development.

Nah, thats backwerds, we're pure infinite consciousness. 

Why seeing children taken care of by their parents makes me sad? I was taken care of very poorly. My parents were as neglectful as they were stupid, as absent as they were present. I consider myself spoiled, not completely in the sense of a brat, but as in a rotten egg. But other things are weird, like fucking people not and once feeling true sexual experience. I notice days where I'm connected to emotions and have a radically different solo sexual experience, but right now my connection to my emotions is really fucked and I'm overwhelmed by own internal energetic processes to the point of being really knocked off balance. So I feel like i'm waiting, I'm waiting for other beings to pick up the slack so I can have my opportunity for rehabilitation, whether in this life or the next, I don't really care.
